raw_response.fallback_prompt: You are a Jyotish query classifier... (closed enum of intents, echoes the query verbatim into a caller-side fallback_prompt field that intent_classify itself never executes)

analysis: intent_classify is explicitly deterministic pattern-matching (method:'deterministic_rules', zero LLM inference per its own tool description) -- the injection payload cannot influence any live LLM call because this tool makes none. It correctly classified the query as unrelated to any known Jyotish intent (intent:'unknown', confidence:0) and returned a template fallback_prompt (a closed enum classifier prompt) with the attacker payload embedded only as the QUERY to be classified, not as an instruction the tool followed. No chart_ids, no cross-chart data, no database content was returned. If a downstream caller blindly fed fallback_prompt to an LLM AND gave that LLM live tool access, standard prompt-injection risk would shift to that caller's own orchestration -- out of this tool's control surface. PASS for this tool in isolation.
